explainer.title: How credits work
explainer.intro: Every plan includes credits, and you see an estimate before anything runs. You are never charged for a failure on our side, and no plan upgrades itself.
explainer.packsNote: Buy a pack from Plan and billing whenever you need more, on any paid plan. Pack credits last {months} months. Nothing tops up automatically.

points.supplied: Credits are spent when ReelBolt supplies the AI or does the rendering for you.
points.estimate: Before each run you see about how many credits it will use, and usually a range.
points.free: File summaries, search across your files and storage within your plan are free.
points.byo: Connect your own AI provider and that usage costs no credits; you pay the provider directly.
points.runner: Work on a machine you own and pair with your workspace costs no credits either.
points.refund: If a run fails because of a problem on our side, the credits for the failed step come back automatically.
